content: Presidency of Migration Management guidance explains that applicants need a passport or substitute travel document lasting at least sixty days beyond the residence-permit period requested. Required documents depend on the residence-permit purpose and are listed in the application form and e-Ikamet guidance. Approval is an authority decision, not a consequence of completing a local checklist. This is a paraphrased guidance excerpt retrieved on the stated date; it does not amend the deterministic project rules.

Sabanci IRO instructs exchange students to collect their supporting documents and arrange online residence-permit preparation. Address evidence differs by accommodation: a dormitory certificate, a rental agreement or a notarized commitment may apply; an Airbnb booking alone is not accepted. After completing the online application, students should print and sign it. The guidance next describes payment, obtaining fingerprint/GI evidence, online document review by IRO and an appointment for physical delivery. IRO asks for scans by email before accepting an office submission and offers technical help at irolegal@sabanciuniv.edu. Fees and submission windows change, so check the current official calendar instead of relying on stored dates. Migration Management decides the residence-permit outcome. This paraphrased excerpt is semantic guidance, not proof that any action has happened in a user case.
